guide.autoturgy.0:
AUTOTURGY · FIELD NOTES
Magical automation through measured signals, physical storage, golem work, essentia, fluids, constructs and portable tools. Complete the Autoturgy research to unlock its magical recipes. Search these notes by name or aspect; hover an aspect icon to read its name. Scroll long pages with the mouse wheel.
guide.autoturgy.1:
DIRECTION & CONTROL
Place a device with its marked face toward you. The marked front emits power; the rear receives it. Right-click empty-handed for controls. A clock can also be started by sneak-clicking it. A comparator reads progress or measured strength. Never point an output back into its own input.
guide.autoturgy.2:
ORDINARY HOURGLASS
Choose 5–60 seconds in five-second steps. Sneak-click, use Start, or apply a rising signal at the rear. The clock runs once and ends with a two-tick pulse. The comparator rises from 0 to 15 as time passes. Elapsed time is saved; unloading pauses time.
guide.autoturgy.3:
MAGIC HOURGLASS
Set precise whole seconds up to one hour. Outputs: completion pulse, power while running, a latch alternating at each completion, power while running with a repeat gap, or disabled. Repeat starts another period. Restart permits a new trigger to reset elapsed time. Cancel-on-falling clears the current period. Powered/unpowered trigger modes pause time when their condition is absent; Ignore waits for manual activation and ignores redstone.
guide.autoturgy.4:
REDCRYSTAL ROUTING
Crystals attach to the face you place them against. Adjacent crystals on that same surface share signals. Enabled corner routing wraps a shared support block. Each world-direction face can be Off, Input, Output, or Both. Normal propagation loses one strength per surface step. Internal power can exceed 15; emitted vanilla power is capped at 15. A graph above 512 crystals refuses power.
guide.autoturgy.5:
SPECIAL REDCRYSTALS
Amplified crystals raise positive input to 31. Dim crystals cap signals; Dense crystals reject weak input. Resonating pairs carry signals straight up to 15 blocks without distance loss. Mercurial crystals attach beside paired mirrors: copy each adjacent mirror into its crystal with an eye. The mirror-facing connection carries internal power to the crystal beside the other end. Both ends must already be loaded and paired. Removing sources turns even zero-loss cycles off.
guide.autoturgy.6:
EYES & REMOTE READINGS
Sneak-use a crystalline eye on the target face; its tooltip records dimension, position and face. Use it on a reader to copy the link without consuming the eye. Targets must be loaded, in the same dimension and within 20 blocks. The remote comparator reads a target with a comparator output. Invalid targets produce zero; readers never load chunks.
guide.autoturgy.7:
VIS READER
Place beneath a jar, crucible, node, wand-bearing Arcane Workbench or Recharge Pedestal. A bound Remote Comparator directly above can instead bridge a target within 20 blocks. An eye copied onto the reader overrides either arrangement. A reader beneath an Essentia Locus pool reads its combined contents. Choose Total, Highest, Lowest or Aspect Count; invert if needed. Select an aspect icon or all aspects. Capacity 0 uses the target capacity; infusion demand and unknown stores need a manual value. Wand amounts use centivis. Node Highest and Lowest compare current fullness with base capacity, including depleted aspects. Reading never consumes essentia.
guide.autoturgy.8:
RUNIC FILTERS
Open a filter and click a carried stack into a ghost square; your real stack stays on the cursor. Left-click with an empty cursor clears a sample. Right-click an existing sample with an empty cursor increases its quantity; Shift-click an inventory stack adds a sample. Blacklist toggles conversion without clearing data. Components, damage, shared item tags and matching mod can be selected independently. Sneak-use while another filter is in your off hand to copy all settings. Apply a filter to a tally by right-clicking it.
guide.autoturgy.9:
TALLY & ENTITY SENSING
A fresh Tally reads the inventory behind its marked output face, through the face toward the box. An overhead bound Remote Comparator bridges a distant target; a copied eye overrides both. Targets must be loaded and in range. Aggregate Count maps matching stock between Minimum and Full-strength. All Quantities requires every filter sample to reach its written amount; Any Quantity requires one. Blacklists instead accept counts below each written limit. Empty lists satisfy neither quantity rule. Unbound and Yield are physical paid lenses: use one on an empty box to install it, sneak-use with an empty hand to recover it. Breaking the box returns its lens. Clear is the unmodified box. Unbound observes loose items near the target. Yield predicts ordinary and Silk Touch drops without breaking the block; variable drops are sampled. Entity Eyes bind creature types or individual players; sneak-use to bind yourself. Signum Entia counts entities in an eleven-wide box shaped by adjacent solid faces. One blocked side extends the opposite reach to ten; two blocked ends suppress that axis. Glass and replaceable blocks are ignored. Age applies only to living creatures; player identity may be required or ignored.
guide.autoturgy.10:
RECIPES & PROGRESSION
Open the Autoturgy category in the research book after unlocking Artifice. Complete its normal knowledge and obtain stages. Magical devices use arcane or infusion recipes with real research, crystals, wand vis and/or essentia. The ordinary inverter, ordinary hourglass, field guide, soup and milk conversion are intentional mundane crafts. Recipe amounts and costs are modern defaults, not claims of unknown historical numbers.
menu.autoturgy.request_modifiers: Shift changes a stack; Ctrl multiplies by ten. Alt permits requests above stock. Linked workers collect and deliver orders.
message.autoturgy.tome_unavailable: Needs a loaded linked core, adjacent memory and nearby Ordo relay.
tooltip.autoturgy.hand_mirror: Sneak-use a paired mirror to link. Use with an opposite-hand list to copy it; sneak-use copies the second list. Automatic mode sends explicitly listed items only.
guide.autoturgy.11:
PHYSICAL STORAGE
Place Hungry or Finical Maws against any inventory face. They absorb nearby loose items into that face and leave overflow in the world. Finical applies an attached runic filter. Chests hold 27 stacks. Tenacious reserves one of each item type against automation across all slots; its normal player slots allow manual removal. Breaking chests drops their contents once. A remote comparator can read their real fullness.
guide.autoturgy.12:
GREEDY & EAGER CHESTS
Greedy watches enabled acquisition directions every ten ticks, taking only positive new deposits after its initial baseline. Share accumulates fractional percentages fairly even for single-item deposits; Own stock fills a target; Neighbor reserve takes new excess. Apply a filter and use a stick for controls. Hoppers below and reciprocal greedy acquisition are refused, while ordinary bottom inventories and one-way greedy sharing work. Eager trades only with its owner and authorized users. Whitelist quantities restock the player, deposit excess and return nonlisted chest items. Blacklist mode deposits nonlisted items and returns listed chest surplus above the configured chest reserve. Sneaking bypasses trade. The owner applies a player-bound entity eye to authorize, or sneak-applies it to revoke. Contents remain normal manual storage.
guide.autoturgy.13:
INVENTARIUM STRUCTURE
Build amber block or amber bricks, a Ordo crystal directly above, then the core directly above that. Eight eligible bookshelves anywhere in the radius-three cube complete this modern arrangement. All shelves in that cube add capacity: ordinary 81, Enchanting 216, Ensorcelled 486, with a modern safety cap of 16384 slots. The special shelves provide 4 and 8 ordinary shelves of enchanting power. One baseline scribe plus one per nearby Ordo crystal is allowed; each crystal also adds 8 to the base link distance of 10. The core never owns or creates indexed items. Its menu toggles tally between stock and demand; a tally can also read a core shelf or a remote comparator linked to the core.
guide.autoturgy.14:
SCRIBES & OCULUS
Bind an eye to the core and attach it to a Scribe in range. The first inventory found directly behind its marked face selects the default container type. The default scan is a 7-cube and costs one real centivis Ordo per scan, normally once a second, through a Vis Relay. A stick opens access-face controls; Reset Type in the contents menu, or sneak-click, forgets the default type. Empty-hand right-click shows local or whole-system contents. Put an Oculus above it and copy up to five eyes: every eye aimed at that scribe adds one to scan radius; other eyes add the loaded container type they observe. These may be mixed. Empty-hand click removes the last eye. Scribes deduplicate storage including double chests, require whole-container capacity, honor selected sides and never load chunks.
guide.autoturgy.15:
REQUESTS & MEMORY
Place one Memory for each Taskmaster, placed Tome or Dispersing Mirror. Eligible Memory lies in the 7×2×7 area two and three below the core and touches amber; every physical Memory grants exactly one persistent device slot. Place a Tome, then copy a core-bound eye into it. Range follows the same 10+8-per-crystal rule, and it needs a steady Ordo relay supply at one centivis per second. Search or sort the complete live catalogue and use arrows or the wheel to page. Stock, reserved and wanted are separate. Plus/minus changes your own orders; Shift changes stacks, Ctrl multiplies by ten, Alt allows more than stock. Click a cursor item into the ghost square, or Shift-click inventory, to request an out-of-stock identity without consuming it. Zero cancels. Link a Taskmaster and suitable golems to collect and deliver orders. Reduced or cancelled orders return carried surplus safely. Full destinations leave goods in the golem’s hands.
guide.autoturgy.16:
MIRROR TRANSPORT
Melding copies an eye aimed at the entrance of a real paired mirror route. Hand, hopper and loose-item input emerge from the paired exit; cross-dimension endpoints must already be loaded. A placed Tome has a real input slot. Its Mirrors button chooses input or output configuration; close the menu, then apply an eye aimed at a mirror within 16 blocks. Input uses that mirror route; output names the actual local output mirror or Melding adapter. Dispersing binds a core eye and consumes dedicated Memory. It routes explicitly earmarked real worker custody to multiple tomes; ordinary matching input is always refused. Hungry Hand sneak-binds a paired mirror. Use an opposite-hand filter to copy list one, or sneak-use for list two. Automatic mode, toggled by sneak-use air, transfers only explicitly listed types. Whitelists send listed items; blacklist quantities retain a reserve and send surplus. Empty lists do nothing. Ordinary use can send an opposite-hand real stack manually. Invalid/full routes preserve all remainders. No addon route loads chunks.

guide.autoturgy.17:
THIRSTY TANK
A tank holds 16 buckets and exposes a pipe connection on every face. Buckets and pipes work; water bottles and stew bowls each carry 250 mB. Every second it follows one connected fluid path up to 16 blocks and 256 visited positions, collecting one bucketable source only after checking space. Adjacent water sources remain renewable. Exposed rain adds 25 mB per collection. Breaking the tank drops one tank preserving its fluid and glyphs; placed tanks restore that data.
guide.autoturgy.18:
FACE GLYPHS
Apply a physical glyph to an empty face. Sneak-use that face with a stick or wand to remove it. The control screen displays all six slates. Void accepts compatible overflow and destroys the excess. Each Consumption drains 100 mB per collection while respecting Preservation. Siphoning pushes up to one bucket out that face; Envy pulls one bucket from it. Temperance requires redstone for all intake. Preservation retains the last 1 mB. Each Guzzler speeds the collection period from 20 ticks, capped at 2. Each Reservoir adds 16 buckets; removal refuses when current contents exceed the smaller capacity. Each Bovine looks four blocks along its face for adult cows and disables world absorption. A persisted per-cow 1200-tick cooldown is shared by every tank.
guide.autoturgy.19:
MILK & SOUP
Craft a milk bucket into a Pouring Milk Bucket; ordinary use drinks and removes effects, sneak-use places a stable milk source. It can be bucketed back into ordinary milk and piped normally. This modern source does not spread. Mushroom and vishroom soup have flowing source blocks and placeable buckets. Four bowls fill a bucket; bowls return when eaten or poured. Vishroom stew uses vishroom, gives little food, nausea, hunger and one temporary warp. Vishroom source immersion gives nausea and one temporary warp at most once every 200 ticks. Source random ticks can grow real vishrooms within two blocks where they survive. No exact legacy rate is claimed.
guide.autoturgy.20:
ALCHEMICAL BOILER
Insert fluid by bucket or pipe and real fuel by hand or item automation. Stack up to five alembics directly above it. A complete 1000 mB batch takes 100 fuel ticks; up to four correctly aimed bellows accelerate progress. Alumentum uses its burn duration. Every resulting aspect must fit the alembics before work begins. Full output stalls without consuming fluid. The paid pending aspects persist if an output changes. Water, lava, milk and other indexed bucket fluids yield their actual bucket aspects minus the empty bucket’s aspects. Soup uses four net bowl servings. Unknown or empty net yields produce nothing. Breaking a boiler destroys contained fluid and paid pending aspects, and drops unused fuel.
guide.autoturgy.21:
ESSENTIA LOCUS CONSTRUCT
Modern explicit shape: lapis in the center of a 3×3 pool of eight water sources, enclosed by a complete 5×5 outer ring of silverwood planks at the same height. Put an Aqua crystal cluster over lapis and the locus over that. Apply a bound eye to a loaded real jar or reservoir; it is physically inserted. Empty-hand click removes the last eye; sneak-empty-hand opens status. Connected containers flood outward from each eye, deduplicated, initially 12 jars and one eye within 16 blocks. Up to eight extra Aqua clusters touching the wood ring add eight jars, one eye and eight range each. Removing required structure disables reading and extraction immediately. Remote readers target the locus; a Vis Reader beneath any water square also reads the combined amounts and labeled capacities.
guide.autoturgy.22:
ESSENTIA AGGREGATOR
Craft the aggregator with an actual Aqua cluster and place it directly below an existing locus, replacing the center cluster. Its visible embedded crystal preserves that resource; lapis, water and silverwood remain mandatory. The locus keeps its inserted eyes. The aggregator lets tubes, infusion altars and Essentia Mirrors draw directly from the monitored jars. Tubes, infusion and essentia mirrors extract from those jars once, respecting output sides and labels. No essentia is stored in the aggregator or reconstructed from readings. Removing an eye, jar or construct block changes the available source immediately. Relabeling a jar changes its per-aspect capacity, including empty labeled jars.

guide.autoturgy.23.title: Golems: links and inhibition
guide.autoturgy.23.body: Place an Inhibitor, Taskmaster or Workbench. Use a Golem Linking Bell on the device, then on your own Thaumaturge golem. Only its owner may control it. One golem has one device; each device has at most six golems. Sneak-use the bell on a device to clear every link; sneak-use another block to clear attunement. Links persist without loading remote chunks. An inhibitor needs active fetters directly below it: one to four consecutive fetters give modern radii of 8, 16, 24 and 32 blocks. Its control menu selects exemption (0) or only linked targets (1). It affects only its owner's golems and yields to combat. Overlapping devices share the pause naturally; removing, disabling or unloading the last effect restores ordinary goals. Existing pauses and physical fetters remain respected. Linking and work require the same dimension. Changing dimension clears the device link; carried orders recover their physical items locally.
guide.autoturgy.24.title: Taskmasters: physical deliveries
guide.autoturgy.24.body: Bind a crystalline eye to a functional Inventarium Core, then attach it to a Taskmaster. Allocate a separate valid memory block for each Taskmaster and each placed Tome. The core's cluster-expanded link range applies. Link up to six fill-compatible golems whose home centers lie within five blocks. Fill workers must not be Clumsy; advanced builds also carry Smart. Hands, legs and home must permit the journey. A paid, operational Tome chooses a nearby output through an eye and submits orders. Workers walk to indexed sided sources, extract real items, carry them in hands and walk to the current allowed destination. A full or unloaded destination leaves custody in those hands. Cancellation returns surplus to the source or drops it safely when that source cannot accept it. Combat, owner-following and external pauses suspend work. Dispersing Mirrors accept only goods assigned to an order. Clear links to recover a stuck worker before reassigning it. Workers interact within two blocks of the physical block surface. Reloaded carried journeys continue walking while retaining the original home and range.
guide.autoturgy.25.title: Golem crafting
guide.autoturgy.25.body: Link an owned Empty-compatible golem with its home within five blocks. Empty workers must not be Clumsy; a Smart head enables advanced patterns. In the Workbench menu, copy items from your cursor into nine blue ghost slots; place real ingredients in the middle storage. Use ordinary crafting recipes. Basic golems handle patterns fitting 2 by 2 or using one ingredient type throughout; Smart golems use the whole grid. Product filters may be attached with a runic filter. Products accumulate on the right and route through the marked front into a sided inventory. Bottom automation extracts products; other faces access real ingredients. A fetter immediately below pauses crafting while output continues. Ingredient remainders return to storage; unrelated containers drop unless Order retains them. A nearby real Fabrico jar within two horizontal blocks and one vertical block supplies one essentia for forty endurance points when fatigue reaches twenty. Long work becomes slower after stored Fabrico is exhausted; resting restores endurance. All ingredients and buckets remain physical.
guide.autoturgy.26.title: Four workbench sides
guide.autoturgy.26.body: Use an upgrade on an empty cardinal side. Sneak-use that side with an empty hand or wand to recover it. Four sides allow four upgrades. Air uses movement speed to reduce the work interval and increases fatigue. Earth uses the greater of material strength and attack damage for a smaller speed improvement and lowers fatigue. Each Fire adds one pattern page; at most two give three pages. Removing Fire retains dormant ghost patterns and all real contents. Order stores noningredient remainders where space permits. Entropy is unique: the real first ingredient slot identifies a placeholder; other stored items may replace all matching ghost cells only when a valid crafting recipe produces the nominal product or a product explicitly allowed by your attached filter. Invalid combinations never consume ingredients. Modern Water adaptation: adjacent real water increases resting recovery by three points per Water side every second. Base work interval is forty ticks, at least four after upgrades; normal recovery is one endurance point per second. These are documented modern tuning defaults.

guide.autoturgy.27.title: Sky-fed harnesses
guide.autoturgy.27.body: Build a single column on chiseled quartz: two to six Thaumostatic Pylons and one Spire controller in any order, then a Thaumium Block cap. Leave air above it and open sky. Use a wand after completing Spires research; each start costs 100 Aer centivis. Use the wand again, or Stop in the menu, to stop. Configure each face:0 closed,1 Potentia,2 Aer,3 Volatus. Host tubes or ordinary held jars supply real essentia. Use a jar on its selected face to transfer up to 8; sneak-use a jar to recover up to 8. Buffers hold 64 of each aspect,256 total, and remain in the dropped controller.

guide.autoturgy.28.title: Spire structure and rates
guide.autoturgy.28.body:
Original side view, bottom to top:
Q = chiseled quartz
P = pylon; C = controller
T = Thaumaturge thaumium

Example: Q / P / C / P / T / open sky.
Modern defaults: radius 8+2 per pylon, with no vertical distance limit. One Aer essentia per successful player batch extends radius by 8. One Volatus per successful batch doubles the base pylon-count transfer rate. Each Potentia delivered costs one owned Potentia plus one actual Aer centivis from a nearby relay. guide.autoturgy.30.title: Weights, materials and Celerity
guide.autoturgy.30.body: Rock draws netherrack; Sea lava; Crystal quartz ore; Light glowstone; Soul soul sand. Pebble draws gravel: an explicit modern role, since its historical public description is unavailable. Base weights are 4 Rock and 1 Sea. Each matching rune adds 4 weight. At four TOTAL block runes, all absent types are excluded; four identical runes select only that type. A matching rune reduces that material cost once, regardless of duplicates. Base material costs: Terra 2 Rock/Pebble; Ignis 4 Sea; Vitreus 4 Crystal; Lux 4 Light; Spiritus 4 Soul. Each operation also costs Ignis 1 essentia and 5 Ignis relay centivis. Celerity caps at 12: interval 200-15 per rune, minimum 20 ticks. The first four multiply all per-operation costs by 1+their count (max 5). These are balanced modern constants, not recovered legacy values. Six face port choices:0 closed;1 Ignis;2 Terra;3 Vitreus;4 Lux;5 Spiritus;6 Bestia;7 Exanimis;8 Volatus;9 Auram.

guide.autoturgy.32.title: Creatures, stability and safety
guide.autoturgy.32.body: Piglin runes summon actual zombified piglins; Blaze, Ghast, Wither Skeleton and Magma Cube use vanilla entities. Firebat and Wisp use actual Thaumaturge entities; wisps are explicitly set to Ignis. Upper cost per spawn: Ignis 2 plus 3 Exanimis for piglin/skeleton, Ignis for blaze, Volatus for ghast, Bestia for cube/bat, Auram for wisp. Lower cost: Alienis 2+Potentia 1. Each end additionally pays 5 centivis through its own relay: upper Ignis, lower Perditio. Celerity multiplies these costs as above. Both ends pay only a successful spawn. On a blaze operation a modern 1/8 chance adds at most one extra real blaze if space permits, plus 8 instability, without another base charge. At instability 20+, piglins have a 1/4 chance to anger at a nearby survival player for 200 ticks. Four lower corner pillars at offsets(+/-3,+/-3) use up to 4 actual obsidian totems each; equal nonzero heights add 4 stability. Each totem adds 1; nitor atop a pillar or under a cardinal upper arm at distance 2 adds 2. Instability gain=max(0,4+2*Celerity-stability); it decays 1/second. At 80 both ends safely stop. Restart after cooling. All probabilities/costs are explicit bounded modern defaults.

guide.autoturgy.33.title: Siren attraction and resistance
guide.autoturgy.33.body: Put the Siren within a vertical line of at least two obsidian totems, above or below it. At most 16 totems each way are counted. Range follows the column and extends 4 blocks beyond each end. Wand start costs 100 Ordo centivis and completed Sirens research. Each second with at least one eligible winning target costs 1 actual Potentia essentia; idle empty periods cost nothing. Base horizontal radius 12;1 additional Desiderium extends it to 24 for that paid second. Desiderium replaces the older hunger aspect for this lure. Ports:0 closed,1 Potentia,2 Desiderium. Strongest column wins; equal columns compare radius then stable block coordinates. Idle susceptible mobs walk using ordinary navigation. Bosses, golems, slimes, seated pets, leashed mobs and recent combat are excluded. Attraction ends when the lure stops. A blocked mob after 100 ticks, a lingering arrival after 40, or a 200-tick attraction gets 600 ticks resistance to that lure. Endermen may make a safe nearer teleport of at most 4 blocks after stalling, with their ordinary teleportation. Disable, break and unload release movement. Another lure may still attract a resistant mob.

research.autoturgy.experience.title: Keeping Experience
research.autoturgy.experience.study: Study the materials and record a plan for keeping experience.
research.autoturgy.experience.complete: Amnesiac Stones hold 2,000 experience points. Use one to remove a level, or sneak-use for five; standing on it drains ten points every four ticks. A brain jar above collects its buffer. Soul Stones hold 10,000 points and drip ten per second into an empty unlabeled warded jar below; an open Item Grate passes the drip. Concentrate jars keep their balance when moved. Phials carry 100 points; ordinary bottles spend 20 points. Breaking either stone releases half its buffer.
research.autoturgy.collecting_pearls.stu: Study the materials and record a plan for collecting pearls.
research.autoturgy.collecting_pearls.com: Throw an Avarice Pearl to gather loose items within 2½ blocks into your inventory. It returns after flight unless a heavy collection shatters it; large collections may also hurt. A Miser Pearl costs 25 Ordo centivis from a carried wand, gathers at most ten stacks and never harms or shatters. A dispenser returns the pearl and goods to itself. Fragments attract nearby idle Endermen. Pech value Mercatus Amalgam.
research.autoturgy.ender_disjunction.stu: Study the materials and record a plan for ender disjunction.
research.autoturgy.ender_disjunction.com: Equip the Lesser or full Ring of Ender Disjunction in a ring slot. Nearby ender creatures take three damage within six blocks for the lesser ring, or six damage within twelve blocks for the full ring, when teleporting into or out of range. Each affected creature costs 25 Perditio centivis from a carried wand. A second ring adds half its strength; further rings add nothing. Runic Shielding can augment either ring.
research.autoturgy.portable_crafting.stu: Study the materials and record a plan for portable crafting.
research.autoturgy.portable_crafting.com: Socket the Crafting Focus in a wand, then use it in air or press Call Crafting Focus, period by default. Opening costs 25 Ordo centivis. The menu supports ordinary and arcane recipes; arcane work requires its research, crystals, local aura and wand vis, plus 25 Ordo centivis per craft. Staves support ordinary recipes only. Paid cumulative infusions add Gratis, Storage and Transposing: remove extra fees, keep inputs, then call from inventory or a Focus Pouch. These infusions replace older focus upgrades.
research.autoturgy.advanced_jarring.stud: Study the materials and record a plan for advanced node jarring.
research.autoturgy.advanced_jarring.comp: Surround a node with the usual three-cube warded-glass shell and a three-by-three silverwood-log lid two blocks above it. Ward every lid log yourself or obtain access. Use an unfocused wand on an accessible lid log with 70 vis of every primal. The shell is consumed and the jar preserves node type, modifier and current, base and original aspects through movement and release. De-energize the node before capture.
research.autoturgy.auxiliary_magic.title: Practical Magic
research.autoturgy.auxiliary_magic.study: Study the materials and record a plan for practical magic.
research.autoturgy.auxiliary_magic.compl: Refine primal slivers or use the alternative paving recipes shown here. Glow Amber and Glow Amber Bricks provide full light. Fishing infusions give an unenchanted rod Luck of the Sea III or Lure III while preserving its name and wear. Already enchanted rods refuse these infusions. Mushroom and Vishroom Soup can be carried in buckets or bowls; Vishroom Stew causes nausea, hunger and temporary warp.
guide.autoturgy.35.title: Keeping experience
guide.autoturgy.35.body: An Amnesiac Stone removes the points between your current level and the previous level. Sneak-use removes up to five levels. Your fractional progress is scaled to the new level with an integer floor; every removed point enters the stone. A full stone takes only what fits. Standing on it drains ten points every four ticks. Its buffer holds 2,000 points. A brain jar directly above collects from that buffer; without a brain, real experience orbs appear. Sneak-use the brain with an empty hand to release its stored points at once. An experience bottle used or thrown onto a stone yields exactly nine points, with no ordinary impact reward.
guide.autoturgy.36.title: Soul stones and concentrate
guide.autoturgy.36.body: A Soul Stone stores up to 10,000 experience points. Connect it beside an Amnesiac Stone and its brain jar to expand the assembly. A comparator on the Amnesiac Stone reads the attached assembly once per physical balance; a Soul Stone reads itself. Soul stones drip ten points each second into an empty, unlabeled warded jar one or two blocks below. A solid block stops the drip. An open item grate lets it through. With open air and no jar, one point is lost each second. These capacities and rates are modern balancing defaults.
guide.autoturgy.37.title: Portable experience
guide.autoturgy.37.body: Concentrate jars keep their full balance when broken and placed again. Each holds 10,000 points. An experience phial withdraws 100 points; drink it to recover all 100, or use it to refill a jar. Ordinary glass bottles instead spend 20 points to make a normal Bottle o’ Enchanting. That unstable bottle cannot refill concentrate and gives the ordinary random reward when thrown. Breaking an Amnesiac or Soul Stone drops half its stored points as orbs and destroys the rest; the dropped stone is empty.
guide.autoturgy.38.title: Collecting pearls
guide.autoturgy.38.body: Throw an Avarice Pearl to gather loose items within 2½ blocks of its flight into your inventory. It flies for at most four seconds and returns once. Larger collections and more distinct loose stacks make it increasingly likely to hurt you or shatter into one fragment. A Miser Pearl gathers at most ten loose stacks, never hurts or shatters, and costs 25 Ordo centivis from a carried wand per manual throw. Dispensers use a calibrated, vis-free launch and return the pearl and collection to their own inventory; full inventories leave safe loose leftovers. Fragments gently draw existing idle nearby Endermen toward their holder, a modern affinity adaptation. Pech value the Desiderium in Mercatus Amalgam.
guide.autoturgy.39.title: Rings of Ender Disjunction
guide.autoturgy.39.body: Equip these rings in ring slots. A nearby ender creature teleport, arriving or departing, deals three damage within six blocks for the lesser ring, or six damage within twelve blocks for the full ring. A second ring adds half its own damage. One teleport costs 25 Perditio centivis from a carried wand per wearer and target, even when both endpoints are in range. No vis means no effect. Further rings add nothing. The normal Runic Shielding augmentation also accepts these rings.
guide.autoturgy.40.title: Crafting away from home
guide.autoturgy.40.body: Socket a Crafting Focus into a wand. Right-use it in air or press the configurable Call Crafting Focus key, period (.) by default, while it is on your hotbar. Opening costs 25 Ordo centivis. Place real ingredients in the grid and primal crystals in the six lower slots. Change mode between Ordinary and Arcane; Craft makes one recipe and returns its remainders. Arcane work pays the recipe’s ordinary research, crystal, local aura and wand costs plus 25 Ordo centivis. A staff supports ordinary recipes only. Closing returns leftovers safely.
guide.autoturgy.41.title: Improving a Crafting Focus
guide.autoturgy.41.body: These cumulative infusion upgrades are a modern alternative to legacy focus upgrades. Gratis removes the extra opening and arcane operation costs. Storage includes Gratis and keeps the real grid and crystals inside the focus when closed. Transposing includes both and swaps itself onto your selected wand when called from inventory or a carried or worn Focus Pouch. The previous focus takes its place. Upgrading preserves stored inputs. Keep the wand in place while the grid is open; changing it closes the grid and returns your inputs.
guide.autoturgy.42.title: Advanced jarring and practical magic
guide.autoturgy.42.body: Build the usual node shell: a 3×3×3 glass volume around the node, excluding its center, plus a 3×3 lid two blocks above. Use warded glass for every glass position and silverwood logs for the lid. Ward every log yourself or gain access from its owner. Use an unfocused wand on a log after Advanced Node Jarring research, with 70 vis of every primal. The shell is consumed instantly and the node’s type, modifier and current, base and original aspects survive the jar’s whole journey. Energized nodes must first be de-energized. Paid sliver refining and alternative travel/warding paving recipes are in Practical Magic. Glow Amber and its bricks emit full light. Fishing infusions give an unenchanted rod Luck of the Sea III or Lure III while retaining its name and wear. Existing enchantments are refused to prevent replacement.

guide.autoturgy.23:
Golems: links and inhibition

Place an Inhibitor, Taskmaster or Workbench. Use a Golem Linking Bell on the device, then on your own Thaumaturge golem. Only its owner may control it. One golem has one device; each device has at most six golems. Sneak-use the bell on a device to clear every link; sneak-use another block to clear attunement. Links persist without loading remote chunks. An inhibitor needs active fetters directly below it: one to four consecutive fetters give modern radii of 8, 16, 24 and 32 blocks. Its control menu selects exemption (0) or only linked targets (1). It affects only its owner's golems and yields to combat. Overlapping devices share the pause naturally; removing, disabling or unloading the last effect restores ordinary goals. Existing pauses and physical fetters remain respected. Linking and work require the same dimension. Changing dimension clears the device link; carried orders recover their physical items locally.
guide.autoturgy.24:
Taskmasters: physical deliveries

Bind a crystalline eye to a functional Inventarium Core, then attach it to a Taskmaster. Allocate a separate valid memory block for each Taskmaster and each placed Tome. The core's cluster-expanded link range applies. Link up to six fill-compatible golems whose home centers lie within five blocks. Fill workers must not be Clumsy; advanced builds also carry Smart. Hands, legs and home must permit the journey. A paid, operational Tome chooses a nearby output through an eye and submits orders. Workers walk to indexed sided sources, extract real items, carry them in hands and walk to the current allowed destination. A full or unloaded destination leaves custody in those hands. Cancellation returns surplus to the source or drops it safely when that source cannot accept it. Combat, owner-following and external pauses suspend work. Dispersing Mirrors accept only goods assigned to an order. Clear links to recover a stuck worker before reassigning it. Workers interact within two blocks of the physical block surface. Reloaded carried journeys continue walking while retaining the original home and range.
guide.autoturgy.25:
Golem crafting

Link an owned Empty-compatible golem with its home within five blocks. Empty workers must not be Clumsy; a Smart head enables advanced patterns. In the Workbench menu, copy items from your cursor into nine blue ghost slots; place real ingredients in the middle storage. Use ordinary crafting recipes. Basic golems handle patterns fitting 2 by 2 or using one ingredient type throughout; Smart golems use the whole grid. Product filters may be attached with a runic filter. Products accumulate on the right and route through the marked front into a sided inventory. Bottom automation extracts products; other faces access real ingredients. A fetter immediately below pauses crafting while output continues. Ingredient remainders return to storage; unrelated containers drop unless Order retains them. A nearby real Fabrico jar within two horizontal blocks and one vertical block supplies one essentia for forty endurance points when fatigue reaches twenty. Long work becomes slower after stored Fabrico is exhausted; resting restores endurance. All ingredients and buckets remain physical.
guide.autoturgy.26:
Four workbench sides

Use an upgrade on an empty cardinal side. Sneak-use that side with an empty hand or wand to recover it. Four sides allow four upgrades. Air uses movement speed to reduce the work interval and increases fatigue. Earth uses the greater of material strength and attack damage for a smaller speed improvement and lowers fatigue. Each Fire adds one pattern page; at most two give three pages. Removing Fire retains dormant ghost patterns and all real contents. Order stores noningredient remainders where space permits. Entropy is unique: the real first ingredient slot identifies a placeholder; other stored items may replace all matching ghost cells only when a valid crafting recipe produces the nominal product or a product explicitly allowed by your attached filter. Invalid combinations never consume ingredients. Modern Water adaptation: adjacent real water increases resting recovery by three points per Water side every second. Base work interval is forty ticks, at least four after upgrades; normal recovery is one endurance point per second. These are documented modern tuning defaults.
